slides.title: The ADHD tax hiding in your house (and how to stop paying it)
Rebuying what you own
slides.body: Tape, batteries, scissors. Pick one drawer as the 'basics' spot. Check it before any store run.

slides.title: Food that goes bad
slides.body: Make an 'eat first' bin at eye level in the fridge. Anything about to turn goes there.

slides.title: Late returns
slides.body: Put return packages in the car right away. The trunk is closer to the store than the hallway.

slides.title: Lost keys, lost time
slides.body: One hook, one bowl, one rule: keys only live there. Every minute searching is a tax too.

slides.title: Subscriptions you forgot
slides.body: Set one phone reminder a month called 'what am I paying for?' Two minutes, done.

slides.title: The ADHD tax isn't a character flaw. It's a missing system, and systems can be built.
Want the systems that stop the tax?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, a 7-day shame-free ADHD home reset. Link in bio.
